title: Normalized principal quotient exact sequence on a flat module
statement: Let R→S be a map of commutative ring sheaves and t a global scalar with an exact sequence 0→R --t→R→Res S→0. If tensoring on the right with M is exact, the normalized coefficient unit η:M→Res(changeOfRings M), given sectionwise by the sheafification of 1⊗x, fits into the short exact sequence 0→M --t→M --η→Res(changeOfRings M)→0.

source.place: Tags 06YP, 06YS, 06YY and Modules on Sites, Tag 03EK; normalized principal quotient construction.

proof.text: Tensor the given short exact sequence with M. Its three objects are identified with M,M,Res(changeOfRings M) by the two regular tensor unitors and the normalized extension-tensor comparison. Precompose the first square with the inverse unitor: tensor balance identifies t⊗x with 1⊗tx. In the second square the image of 1⊗x is 1⊗x because φ(1)=1, hence is η(x). Thus these three isomorphisms form an isomorphism of short complexes. Transport short exactness along it. No lifting of sections along the quotient is used.

    (hz : (scalar R t).app M ≫ η = 0) :
